item.title: Woman dies after riding Revenge of the Mummy attraction at Universal, report says

item.description: In less than a year, Florida voters could hold all the power when deciding whether to reduce or cut property taxes across the state.

item.title: Motorcyclist arrested after crash kills pedestrian in Bradenton, police say
item.description: BRADENTON, Fla. (WFLA) — The Bradenton Police Department said a pedestrian was killed after being struck by two vehicles Friday evening. item.description: Three dogs that were removed from a Bradenton home in October have been approved for future adoption.

item.title: Florida ranks 7th among states with the most collection accounts: study
item.description: A recent study examined which states have the highest number of collection accounts and found Florida ranks seventh, suggesting residents of the Sunshine State may be struggling to pay their bills.
